keyEvents.text: Goal! Cambuur 0, PSV Eindhoven 1. Sven Mijnans (PSV Eindhoven) header from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Esmir Bajraktarevic with a cross.

Goal! Cambuur 0, PSV Eindhoven 2. Sven Mijnans (PSV Eindhoven) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Ruben van Bommel.Goal confirmed following VAR Review.
Goal! Cambuur 0, PSV Eindhoven 3. Ruben van Bommel (PSV Eindhoven) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Esmir Bajraktarevic.
Delay in match (PSV Eindhoven).
Goal! Cambuur 1, PSV Eindhoven 3. Nicky Souren (Cambuur) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner.
First Half ends, Cambuur 1, PSV Eindhoven 3.
Mathieu Maertens (Cambuur) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Cambuur. Sami Bouhoudane replaces Mathieu Maertens.
Sven Mijnans (PSV Eindhoven) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, PSV Eindhoven. Ricardo Pepi replaces Guus Til.
Substitution, PSV Eindhoven. Ayoni Santos replaces Ruben van Bommel.
Morgan Costarelli (Cambuur) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Rafik El Arguioui (Cambuur) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Sergiño Dest (PSV Eindhoven) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Cambuur. Ethan Apkakou replaces Morgan Costarelli.
Substitution, Cambuur. Iwan Henstra replaces Nicolas Binder.
Substitution, PSV Eindhoven. Kiliann Sildillia replaces Sergiño Dest.
Goal! Cambuur 2, PSV Eindhoven 3. Iwan Henstra (Cambuur) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Rafik El Arguioui.
Goal! Cambuur 2, PSV Eindhoven 4. Sven Mijnans (PSV Eindhoven) from a free kick with a left footed shot to the top right corner.
Substitution, PSV Eindhoven. Ryan Flamingo replaces Lutsharel Geertruida.
Substitution, PSV Eindhoven. Dennis Man replaces Esmir Bajraktarevic.
Substitution, Cambuur. Skye Vink replaces Rafik El Arguioui.
Substitution, Cambuur. Fabian Kvam replaces Jason Çeka.
Goal! Cambuur 2, PSV Eindhoven 5. Ayoni Santos (PSV Eindhoven) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Kodai Sano with a cross following a fast break.
